Those who come to China to pursue a master's degree must have a degree equivalent to a bachelor's degree from a Chinese university and be no older than 35 years old. Those who come to China to pursue a doctoral degree must have a degree equivalent to a master's degree from a Chinese university and be no older than 40 years old.(4) Ser amigables con China, diligentes y的事业 eager to learn, have excellent academic performance, good conduct, abide by laws and regulations, have no record of violating school rules and regulations, no public security penalties, and no criminal records.(5) Dominio lingüísticoFor those applying for master's or doctoral degrees in Chinese-taught programs, their Chinese proficiency must reach 180 points or above on the HSK5 level of the Chinese Proficiency Test. To apply for the Master's degree in Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages, one must achieve a score of 210 or above in HSK5 and 60 or above in the Intermediate level of HSKK. Applicants who have used Chinese as the medium of instruction can submit a "Certificate of Teaching in Chinese" issued by their school. After being recognized by our school, they can be exempted from submitting the HSK score certificate.For applications to English-taught programs, if the native language is not English, one must submit proof of TOEFL (TOEFL iBT score of 79 or above, with 15 or above in each section) or IELTS (IELTS Academic score of 6.5 or above, with 5.5 or above in each section) or other proof that can reflect one's English proficiency. Applicants who have used English as the medium of instruction can submit a "Certificate of English Teaching" issued by their school. After being recognized by our school, they will be exempted from submitting the certificate of English proficiency.
